body:
Crumbs CSS v1.0.1 corrects the npm README and packaged compatibility notes, which retained prepublication wording after v1.0.0 had shipped. Onboarding now installs 1.0.1 and links the complete API documentation.

All 105 JavaScript files and 76 declaration files are byte-identical to verified v1.0.0. Exports, dependencies, peer ranges and the license are unchanged; only README, COMPATIBILITY and the package version change.

The one-off documentation publisher checks the exact public v1.0.0 SHA-256 and unchanged product source/config, seals the corrected package, and independently verifies it on a separate host before npm upload with provenance. Eleven positive/negative controls and the 33-page docs build pass. No new performance qualification or future-release exception is claimed; existing v1 evidence and deferred physical acceptance remain recorded.

See [release status](https://github.com/opsydyn/crumbs-css/blob/main/docs/releases/1.0.1.md) and [current docs](https://opsydyn.github.io/crumbs-css/).
